summary: Promoted the witnessed snapshot-trigger mechanism into durable reuse: added an interpretation for the already-asserted question 877a07ed685d42b597310ae204aaf472-question-0 tied to its retained receipt (9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab, parsed indices 0 and 1), where the control sample shows should_snapshot=false while the store still holds entries and the post-compaction sample flips it true with an emptied store and an unchanged commit/applied index of 4, so the verdict is decided by the store-against-snapshot comparison rather than by new work. Conclusion holds with no new defect judgment; the earlier asserted defect, its consequence bound (redundant snapshots at the unchanged index, no safety effect) and its limitations are unchanged, and the follow-on reachability question @q_restore_underflow_default_cfg remains registered with its discriminator.
